meta.title: Vendor declines an event with a reason

steps.note: Create the live event needed for the vendor decline scenario.
Configure the event as an RFQ so the vendor receives a live pricing event.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the required product line for the event.
Complete the pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite the QA vendor whose response will be declined.
Publish the event and make it live for the vendor.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Continue in the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open the event from the vendor's event card on the Event Overview screen.

args.goal: On the vendor Event Overview, click the blue "I don't wish to participate" button, select a reason for not participating in the dialog, and confirm with "I will not participate"; stop when the response is recorded.

steps.note: Perform the vendor decline interaction, including the reason selection and confirmation, which has no dedicated catalog action.

args.text: You've decided to not participate, Want to change your response?

steps.note: Verify the expected non-participation confirmation is displayed at the bottom of the vendor overview.
